move_tensor_to_device: move a PyTorch tensor to the available CUDA or CPU device using to_device
move_dict_of_tensors_to_device: recursively move a dictionary of PyTorch tensors to the GPU or CPU device
move_list_of_tensors_to_device: recursively move a list of PyTorch tensors to the available compute device
move_nested_data_to_device: recursively move nested dicts and lists containing tensors to the CUDA or CPU device
check_default_device: inspect the module-level _device variable to see if CUDA or CPU is selected as the default
